notes: US Ford Ranger compact pickup, 2WD and 4WD, model years 1983-2011 (US production ended Dec 2011; no 2012 US model year). Mazda B-Series and Bronco II excluded. independent_sources counts source groups once each: Ford (all brochures, incl. those hosted by The Ranger Station), Wikipedia, EPA (1984+), The Ranger Station tech tables, Diesel Hub, Mini-Truck magazine 1981, NHRA. Ratings SAE net. Where sources disagree, the Ford brochure figure for that year is used; where no Ford figure exists and others disagree, hp is withheld (null). Hagerty valuation pages now require login and were not used. The 1989 SHO-V6 Ranger GT was a one-off prototype and is excluded.
